xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:BriefDetailsOfCyberSecurityInc: Multiple customers reported fraudulent calls from impersonators claiming delivery issues and requesting QR code payments. The origin of the breach was at a vendors end, when attackers used social engineering techniques to gain unauthorized access to systems that contained customer delivery details. Affected customers were identified and reimbursed, IPs were whitelisted, and user access was restricted to privileged, need-based access.
